                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ ਸਾਪੇਖਿਕ ਗਤੀ = (60 + 70) ਕਿਮੀ/ਘੰਟਾ = 130 ਕਿਮੀ/ਘੰਟਾ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ ਮੀਟਰ/ਸੈਕਿੰਡ ਵਿੱਚ = 130 x (5 ÷ 18) = 36.11 ਮੀਟਰ/ਸੈਕਿੰਡ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ ਸਮਾਂ = 26 ਸਕਿੰਟ, ਦੂਰੀ = ਲੰਬਾਈ₁ + ਲੰਬਾਈ₂

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ 26 = (170 + ਲੰਬਾਈ₂) ÷ 36.11

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ 170 + ਲੰਬਾਈ₂ = 26 x 36.11 = 938.86

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ ਲੰਬਾਈ₂ = 938.86 − 170 = 768.86

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ∴ ਸਹੀ ਉੱਤਰ 768.86 ਮੀਟਰ ਹੈ।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\\(\\text{(Use } \\pi = \\frac{22}{7} \\text{)}\\)", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "31 मीटर"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "32 मीटर"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "30 मीटर"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "33 मीटर"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "bn": {"value": "একটি চোঙাকৃতির ট্যাংকের ধারণক্ষমতা 4774 ঘনমিটার। যদি ভূমির ব্যাসার্ধ 7 মিটার হয়, তবে গভীরতা কত হবে?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n(ধরি \\(\\pi = \\frac{22}{7} \\text{)}\\)", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "31 মিটার"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "32 মিটার"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "30 মিটার"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "33 মিটার"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "gu": {"value": "એક નળાકાર ટાંકીની ક્ષમતા 4774 મી³ છે. જો આધારની ત્રિજ્યા 7 મી હોય, તો ઊંડાઈ કેટલી છે?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\\(\\text{(Use } \\pi = \\frac{22}{7} \\text{)}\\)", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "31 મી"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "32 મી"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "30 મી"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "33 મી"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "kn": {"value": "ಒಂದು ಸಿಲಿಂಡರಾಕಾರದ ತೊಟ್ಟಿ 4774 ಮೀ³ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯವನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿದೆ. ಒಂದು ವೇಳೆ ಪಾದದ ತ್ರಿಜ್ಯ 7 ಮೀ ಆಗಿದ್ದರೆ, ಆಳ ಎಷ್ಟು?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\\(\\text{(Use } \\pi = \\frac{22}{7} \\text{)}\\)", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "31 ಮೀ"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "32 ಮೀ"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "30 ಮೀ"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "33 ಮೀ"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "ta": {"value": "ஒரு உருளை வடிவ தொட்டியின் கொள்ளளவு 4774 மீ³ ஆகும். அதன் அடிப்பாகத்தின் ஆரம் 7 மீ என்றால், அதன் ஆழம் என்ன?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\\((\\text{பயன்படுத்தவும் } \\pi = \\frac{22}{7} \\text{)}\\)", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "31 மீ"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "32 மீ"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "30 மீ"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "33 மீ"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "or": {"value": "ଏକ ସିଲିଣ୍ଡରାକୃତି ଟାଙ୍କିର କ୍ଷମତା 4774 m³ ଅଟେ | ଯଦି ଭିତ୍ତିର ବ୍ୟାସାର୍ଦ୍ଧ 7 ମିଟର ହୁଏ, ତେବେ ଏହାର ଗଭୀରତା କେତେ?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\\(\\text{(} \\pi = \\frac{22}{7} \\text{ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ)}\\)", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "31 ମିଟର"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "32 ମିଟର"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "30 ମିଟର"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "33 ମିଟର"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}, "pa": {"value": "ਇੱਕ ਸਿਲੰਡਰ ਟੈਂਕ ਦੀ ਸਮਰੱਥਾ 4774 m³ ਹੈ। ਜੇਕਰ ਅਧਾਰ ਦਾ ਅਰਧ ਵਿਆਸ 7m ਹੈ, ਤਾਂ ਡੂੰਘਾਈ ਕਿੰਨੀ ਹੈ?
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\\(\\text{(ਵਰਤੋਂ } \\pi = \\frac{22}{7} \\text{)}\\)", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "31 m"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "32 m"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "30 m"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "33 m"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "1", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Base Area of Cylinder = π × r2 = (22 ÷ 7) × 7 × 7 = 154 m2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Volume of Cylinder = Base Area × Depth

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ Depth = Volume ÷ Base Area

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ Depth = 4774 ÷ 154 = 31 m

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ∴ The correct answer is 31 m.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Capacity (Volume) of the cylindrical tank, V = 4774 m3

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Radius of the base, r = 7 m

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Volume of a cylinder (V) = π × r2 × h

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Where r is the radius and h is the depth (height) of the cylinder.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n\n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Calculation:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ 4774 = (22 ÷ 7) × 72 × h

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ 4774 = (22 ÷ 7) × 49 × h

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ 4774 = 22 × 7 × h

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ 4774 = 154 × h

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ h = 4774 ÷ 154

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ h = 31 m

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ∴ The correct answer is 31 m.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Curved Surface Area of a Cylinder

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The lateral or curved surface area is calculated as CSA = 2 × π × r × h.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Total Surface Area of a Cylinder

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              It includes the areas of both circular bases and the curved surface: TSA = 2 × π × r × (r + h).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Volume of a Cone

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              A cone with the same base radius and height has one-third the volume of a cylinder: V = (1 ÷ 3) × π × r2 × h.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ 4774 = 22 x 7 x h

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ 4774 = 154h

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ h = 31 मीटर

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ∴ टैंक की गहराई = 31 मीटर

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              స్థూపం యొక్క ఘనపరిమాణం = πr2h

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n", "bn": "

(ਨਜ਼ਦੀਕੀ ਰੁਪਏ ਤੱਕ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰੋ।)", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": " 5,233"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "5,112"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "5,322"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "5,421"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Selling Price = Marked Price × Multiplying factor for discount

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              SP = 6490 × (100 − 18)%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              SP = 6490 × 0.82

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              SP = 5321.8 ≈ 5322 (Rounded off to nearest rupee)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ∴ The correct answer is ₹5,322.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Marked Price (MP) of the injection = ₹6,490

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Discount percentage = 18%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Selling Price (SP) = MP × (100 − Discount%) ÷ 100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n\n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Calculations:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ SP = 6490 × (100 − 18) ÷ 100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ SP = 6490 × 82 ÷ 100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ SP = 649 × 8.2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ SP = 5321.8

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ Rounding off to the nearest rupee, SP ≈ 5322

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ∴ The correct answer is ₹5,322.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Marked Price & Discount

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Discount is always calculated on the Marked Price (MP) of an article. It represents the reduction in price offered by the seller. The direct formula is Discount = MP − SP.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Successive Discounts

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              When two successive discounts of D1% and D2% are given, the Effective Discount Percentage is equivalent to: (D1 + D2 − (D1 × D2) ÷ 100)%.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Profit/Loss vs Discount Relation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Profit or Loss is always evaluated over the Cost Price (CP), whereas Discount applies to the Marked Price (MP). They are linked by the fundamental relation: CP × (100 + Profit%) = MP × (100 − Discount%).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ विक्रय मूल्य = ₹6,490 × (1 - 0.18)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ विक्रय मूल्य = ₹6,490 × 0.82

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ விற்பனை விலை = ₹6,490 x (1 - 0.18)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ∴ சரியான பதில் ₹5,322.

{"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Using the ratio method for successive percentage changes:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              15% ↓ ⇒ 20 → 17 | 25% ↓ ⇒ 4 → 3 | 35% ↓ ⇒ 20 → 13 | 40% ↑ ⇒ 5 → 7

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Initial parts product = 20 × 4 × 20 × 5 = 8000

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Final parts product = 17 × 3 × 13 × 7 = 4641

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Decrease % = [(8000 − 4641) ÷ 8000] × 100 = 3359 ÷ 80 = 41.9875% ≈ 41.98%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ∴ The correct answer is 41.98% decrease.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Successive changes in fuel price: Decreases by 15%, 25%, 35%, followed by an increase of 40%.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n
