                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Final Value = Initial Value × (1 ± R1/100) × (1 ± R2/100) × (1 ± R3/100) × (1 ± R4/100)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Calculation:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Let the initial price of the fuel be 100.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ Price after 1st month (15% decrease) = 100 × (1 − 0.15) = 85

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ Price after 2nd month (25% decrease) = 85 × (1 − 0.25) = 63.75

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ Price after 3rd month (35% decrease) = 63.75 × (1 − 0.35) = 41.4375

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ Price after 4th month (40% increase) = 41.4375 × (1 + 0.40) = 58.0125

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ Net decrease in price = Initial Price − Final Price = 100 − 58.0125 = 41.9875

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ Percentage decrease = (41.9875 ÷ 100) × 100% = 41.9875% ≈ 41.98%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ∴ The correct answer is 41.98% decrease.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Successive Percentage Change

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              When a value undergoes successive changes of a% and b%, the net percentage change can be tracked using multiplying factors: Final = Initial × (1 ± a/100) × (1 ± b/100).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Fraction to Percentage Conversion

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Converting percentage changes into fractions immensely simplifies calculation. For example, a 15% decrease becomes a multiplier of 85/100 or 17/20, and a 40% increase becomes 140/100 or 7/5.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Net Percentage Change via Ratio Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              For three or more changes, set up initial and final ratio parts for each step. Multiply all initial parts together and all final parts together to find the overall base and result, then compute the net percentage change directly.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ईंधन की कीमत में क्रमागत परिवर्तन:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              पहला महीना: −15%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              दूसरा महीना: −25%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              तीसरा महीना: −35%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              चौथा महीना: +40%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              क्रमागत परिवर्तन सूत्र: अंतिम मूल्य = प्रारंभिक मूल्य × (1 + r₁/100) × (1 + r₂/100) × (1 + r₃/100) × (1 + r₄/100)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              प्रतिशत परिवर्तन = [(अंतिम मूल्य − प्रारंभिक मूल्य) ÷ प्रारंभिक मूल्य] × 100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ माना प्रारंभिक मूल्य = ₹100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ पहले महीने के", "te": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              విషయం:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ఇంధన ధరలో వరుస మార్పులు:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              1వ నెల: −15%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              2వ నెల: −25%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              3వ నెల: −35%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              4వ నెల: +40%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ఉపయోగించిన సూత్రం:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              వరుస మార్పు సూత్రం: చివరి ధర = ప్రారంభ ధర x (1 + r₁/100) x (1 + r₂/100) x (1 + r₃/100) x (1 + r₄/100)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              శాతం మార్పు = [(చివరి ధర − ప్రారంభ ధర) ÷ ప్రారంభ ధర] x 100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              గణన:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ ప్రారంభ ధర = ₹100 అనుకుందాం

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ 1వ నెల తరువాత: 100 x (1 − 0.15) = 85

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ 2వ నెల తరువాత: 85 x (1 − 0.25) = 85 x 0.75 = 63.75

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ 3వ నెల తరువాత: 63.75 x (1 − 0.35) = 63.75 x 0.65 = 41.4375

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ 4వ నెల తరువాత: 41.4375 x (1 + 0.40) = 41.4375 x 1.40 = 58.0125

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ చివరి ధర = 58.0125

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ తగ్గుదల = 100 − 58.0125 = 41.9875

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ % తగ్గుదల = 41.9875%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ∴ సరైన సమాధానం సుమారుగా 41.99% తగ్గుదల.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n", "mr": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              दिलेल्याप्रमाणे:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              इंधनाच्या किमतीतील क्रमागत बदल:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              पहिला महिना: −15%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              दुसरा महिना: −25%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              तिसरा महिना: −35%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              चौथा महिना: +40%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              वापरलेले सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              क्रमागत बदल सूत्र: अंतिम किंमत = प्रारंभिक किंमत × (1 + r₁/100) × (1 + r₂/100) × (1 + r₃/100) × (1 + r₄/100)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              टक्केवारी बदल = [(अंतिम किंमत − प्रारंभिक किंमत) ÷ प्रारंभिक किंमत] × 100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ समजा प्रारंभिक किंमत = 100 रुपये 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ पहिल्या महिन्यानंतर: 100 × (1 − 0.15) = 85

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ दुसर्‍या महिन्यानंतर: 85 × (1 − 0.25) = 8", "bn": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              প্রদত্ত:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              জ্বালানীর দামে পরপর পরিবর্তন:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              প্রথম মাস: −15%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              দ্বিতীয় মাস: −25%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              তৃতীয় মাস: −35%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              চতুর্থ মাস: +40%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ব্যবহৃত সূত্র:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              পরপর পরিবর্তনের সূত্র: চূড়ান্ত দাম = প্রাথমিক দাম × (1 + r₁/100) × (1 + r₂/100) × (1 + r₃/100) × (1 + r₄/100)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              শতকরা পরিবর্তন = [(চূড়ান্ত দাম − প্রাথমিক দাম) ÷ প্রাথমিক দাম] × 100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              গণনা:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ ধরি, প্রাথমিক দাম = 100 টাকা 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ প্রথম মাসের পর: 100 × (1 − 0.15) = 85

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ দ্বিতীয় মাসের পর: 85 × (1 − 0.25) = 85 × 0.75 = 63.75

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ তৃতীয় মাসের পর: 63.75 × (1 − 0.35) = 63.75 × 0.65 = 41.4375

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ চতুর্থ মাসের পর: 41.4375 × (1 + 0.40) = 41.4375 × 1.40 = 58.0125

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ চূড়ান্ত দাম = 58.0125

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ হ্রাস = 100 − 58.0125 = 41.9875

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ % হ্রাস = 41.9875%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ∴ সঠিক উত্তর হল প্রায় 41.99% হ্রাস।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n174:T869,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              આપેલ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ઇંધણની કિંમતમાં ક્રમિક ફેરફારો:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              પહેલો મહિનો: −15%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              બીજો મહિનો: −25%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ત્રીજો મહિનો: −35%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n
