                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n", "kn": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ನೀಡಲಾಗಿದೆ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ಲ.ಸಾ.ಅ. = 198

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ಮ.ಸಾ.ಅ. = 33

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ಒಂದು ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ = 99

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ಬಳಸಿದ ಸೂತ್ರ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ಲ.ಸಾ.ಅ. x ಮ.ಸಾ.ಅ. = ಎರಡು ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಗಳ ಗುಣಲಬ್ಧ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ಎರಡು ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಗಳ ಗುಣಲಬ್ಧ ÷ ಒಂದು ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ = ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ಲೆಕ್ಕಾಚಾರ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ ಲ.ಸಾ.ಅ. x ಮ.ಸಾ.ಅ. = 198 x 33

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ 198 x 33 = 6534

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ = 6534 ÷ 99

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ 6534 ÷ 99 = 66

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ∴ ಸರಿಯಾದ ಉತ್ತರ 66.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n", "ta": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              கொடுக்கப்பட்டது:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              மீ.சி.ம = 198

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              மீ.பெ.வ = 33

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ஒரு எண் = 99

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              பயன்படுத்தப்படும் சூத்திரம்:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              மீ.சி.ம x மீ.பெ.வ = இரண்டு எண்களின் பெருக்கல்

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              இரண்டு எண்களின் பெருக்கல் ÷ ஒரு எண் = மற்ற எண்

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              கணக்கீடு:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ மீ.சி.ம x மீ.பெ.வ = 198 x 33

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ 198 x 33 = 6534

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ மற்ற எண் = 6534 ÷ 99

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ 6534 ÷ 99 = 66

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ∴ சரியான பதில் 66 ஆகும்.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ସୂତ୍ର ବ୍ୟବହାର କରାଗଲା:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ∴ ସଠିକ୍ ଉତ୍ତର ହେଉଛି 66।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The correct answer is: Timidity.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The word "boldness" refers to the quality of showing courage, confidence, and a willingness to take risks; it demonstrates fearlessness in handling situations. (साहस)\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Example: Her boldness in speaking against injustice inspired many to join the cause.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • "Timidity" refers to a lack of courage or confidence and a tendency to avoid risks or confrontations; it is the opposite of boldness. (भीरुता)\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Example: His timidity prevented him from voicing his opinions in the meeting.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Hence, we can infer that the antonym of 'boldness' is 'timidity'.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Therefore, the correct answer is: Timidity.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The word "Exculpate" means to clear someone from blame or prove that they are not guilty of wrongdoing. (दोषमुक्त करना)\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Example: The lawyer managed to exculpate the defendant with strong evidence proving his innocence.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • "Condemn" refers to expressing complete disapproval of someone, often in a moral or legal sense, or declaring them guilty of a crime. (निंदा करना)\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Example: The jury condemned the defendant for his unethical actions after reviewing all the evidence.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Hence, we can infer that the opposite of 'Exculpate' is 'Condemn'.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Therefore, the correct answer is: Condemn.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Vindicate (सत्य साबित करना): To clear someone of blame or suspicion and prove their innocence.\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Example: The evidence vindicated the accused, showing that they were not involved in the crime.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Absolve (दोषमुक्त करना): To formally declare someone free from guilt, obligation, or punishment.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Example: The priest absolved him of his sins after a heartfelt confession.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Condone (अनदेखा करना): To accept or allow morally wrong behavior to continue.\n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The idiom "To get upper hand" means to gain advantage, control, or dominance over someone or something. (प्रभुत्व प्राप्त करना)\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Example: The team worked hard to get the upper hand in the match and eventually won.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The word "To get upper hand" fits the context of the sentence, as it emphasizes the father’s strong position as an MLA, implying dominance or advantage. (प्रभुत्व की स्थिति)\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Example: His father enjoyed the strongest position as an MLA, clearly having the upper hand in his constituency.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Option 2: To be at one's wit (चिंतित या असमंजस में): Refers to being at a point of extreme anxiety or confusion.\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Example: He was at his wit's end trying to solve the complex puzzle.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Option 3: To be at hem of (प्रारंभिक स्थिति में होना): Refers to being at the beginning or under control of someone.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Example: She was at the hem of her career when she joined the company.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \nFrantic", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "&nbsp;Kinetic"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "&nbsp;Quaint"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "Distraught"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "&nbsp;Magnanimous"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n
