                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The word "Frantic" means showing extreme emotion, often due to stress, worry, or fear; it refers to someone behaving in a wildly excited or hurried way. (उन्मत्त)\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Example: She made frantic calls to her friends when she realized she had lost her wallet.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • "Distraught" refers to someone who is deeply upset, worried, or agitated, often to the point of being unable to think clearly. (हताश)\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Example: He was distraught after hearing the news of his friend’s accident.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Hence, the word "Distraught" is the synonym of "Frantic".
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3 (Distraught).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t

It can also mean intelligent or cheerful. (चमकदार, तेज)\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Example: She looked radiant in her wedding dress.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Hence, the most appropriate meaning of the word "Bright" is "Radiant."

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Therefore, the correct answer is: Radiant.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The word "succinct" means something expressed in a clear, concise, and brief manner, without unnecessary words. (संक्षिप्त)\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Example: Her email response was succinct, covering all key points in just two sentences.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • "Brief" refers to something that is short in duration or length, or concise in expression. (संक्षिप्त)\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Example: The teacher gave a brief explanation of the topic before moving on to the next chapter.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Hence, we can infer that the synonym of 'succinct' is 'brief'.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Therefore, the correct answer is: Brief.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Lengthy (लंबा): Something that is long in duration or contains excessive details.\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The correct answer is: a white elephant.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The phrase "a white elephant" refers to something that is expensive but serves no useful purpose or is considered a burden. (बोझ या अनुपयोगी चीज)\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Example: The government building turned out to be a white elephant as it remained unused for years.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Therefore, the correct answer is: a white elephant.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Hence, the correct sentence is: "Even he carried a load of two baskets, slung on a pole on his shoulder."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option 1 – carried'.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Additional Information
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • carries: Present tense – does not fit the past narrative of the passage.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • carry: Base form of the verb – grammatically incorrect in this context.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • carrying: Continuous form – would require an auxiliary verb (e.g., “was carrying”).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Key Points
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The sentence is: “(3) ______ he kept a folded quilt and a cauldron.”
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The word needed here should indicate place or position, referring to one of the baskets.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • “There” is used correctly to refer to a location — in this case, the basket where the man kept a folded quilt and a cauldron.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Hence, the sentence becomes: “There he kept a folded quilt and a cauldron.” — which is grammatically and contextually correct.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option 2 – There'.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Additional Information
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Than – used for comparison; not suitable here.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • This and That – demonstrative pronouns used to indicate specific objects; they don’t fit grammatically in this sentence.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • There – correctly indicates a place (the basket) where the quilt and cauldron were kept.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Key Points
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The sentence describes the appearance of a quilt that is “ragged and patched, but still clean.”
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The missing word should intensify the description of how ragged the quilt is.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • “Extremely” fits best as it is an adverb used to emphasize a high degree of a quality.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Other options like “frankly”, “eagerly”, or “abruptly” do not describe the condition of an object.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option 2'.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Additional Information
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Frankly – means honestly; used to express truthfulness, not suitable here.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Abruptly – means suddenly; does not fit contextually.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Key Points
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The passage describes an old man walking alone in a procession.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The pronoun used must correctly refer back to the old man, who is male.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • In the phrase “There was no one with _____”, the correct object pronoun referring to a male person is “him.”
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Other options like “his,” “its,” or “her” are incorrect because they either show possession or refer to the wrong gender.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option 1 – him'.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Additional Information
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • his – possessive pronoun, not suitable after “with.”
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • its – refers to a non-living thing or animal, not a person.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • her – feminine pronoun, incorrect because the subject is an old man.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
